name: Sonic / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. One sharp dry tissue snap punched by a narrow air-pressure clap, followed by a very short hollow high ringing ripple. Directional sonic limb severing, compact attack.
